status_note: Locked before any campaign endpoint was read. Wiring probes on n=2 smoke records preceded the lock and are disclosed in the results doc; they confirmed each lever routes and produced no endpoint number.
validate_command: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src python -c "import json; from slm_training.autoresearch.experiment_campaign import ExperimentCampaignV1, CampaignLockV1, campaign_manifest_sha256; d=json.load(open('src/slm_training/resources/experiments/decode_only_authority_ladder/campaign.v1.json')); m=ExperimentCampaignV1.model_validate(d['manifest']); assert campaign_manifest_sha256(m)==d['manifest_sha256']; CampaignLockV1(manifest_sha256=d['manifest_sha256'], manifest=m); print('ok', d['manifest_sha256'])"

manifest.hypothesis: N4: under block_diffusion_decode=True the MaskGIT left-prefix admit_fill probe stops being a pure over-approximation -- parallel in-block commits put a committed token behind the probed hole often enough that the exact multi_region_support joint check rejects at least one step (block_joint_rejections > 0), unlike the 0/60 false-admit rate measured on sequential positionwise commits. Two path-scoped ladders test decode authority: ladder M (MaskGIT positionwise: admit off / left-prefix admit / block diffusion at block sizes 2,4,8) and ladder L (compiler LTR: singleton-only / deterministic n-gram speculative ranking at margins 0.5, 1.0, 2.0). Each candidate is measured against its own ladder's control; the ladders are disjoint decode paths and are never pooled.
manifest.decision: N4_holds iff block_joint_rejections > 0 for at least one of m2_block_diffusion_b2/b4/b8 on at least one suite with no gate regression; N4_falsified iff block_joint_rejections == 0 across all three block sizes, all suites and both seeds. Separately, an authority-ladder arm is 'decision-bearing' iff its legal-choice flip rate against its own ladder control clears 0.01 with no gate regression, and 'forward-saving' iff it saves forwards at matched output. Fixture-scale diagnostic only: no promotion, no checkpoint, no ship-gate, no default change is implied or permitted by any outcome of this campaign.

endpoints.metric: per-position flips against the arm's OWN ladder control, restricted to legal-choice positions: index-aligned positions t of the emitted canvas where force_emit_token_id(tokenizer, control_ids[:t]) is None (the grammar does not already prove the token). flips / legal_choice_positions, pooled over the suite.
control forwards_count minus arm forwards_count, over the records whose emitted program is byte-identical to the control's (matched output); reported with the matched-record count.
DecodeStats.block_joint_rejections summed over the suite: exact multi_region_support verdicts that proved a parallel-commit canvas impossible and reverted the step.
arm meaningful_program_rate minus its ladder control's
arm structural_similarity minus its ladder control's
arm placeholder_fidelity minus its ladder control's

stopping_rules: Every arm x suite x seed decode runs under `timeout 170` on CPU with torch.set_num_threads(2); MAX_RUN_MINUTES=3 (src/slm_training/levers.py). A run that times out or is killed is recorded as an explicit timeout row and is never evidence.
Stop after all 9 arms x 3 suites x 2 seeds, or earlier when every kill criterion for an arm has tripped.
No endpoint is read before this manifest's CampaignLockV1 digest is recorded; any post-lock edit is a CampaignDeviationV1.

controls.description: Diagnostic NEGATIVE control for ladder M: grammar_fastpath_mode='force' turns the admit probe off entirely. This is a legality-weakening configuration, so it is listed in mechanism_off_arm_ids and is never a promotion candidate. It exists to prove the probe machinery is live: admit_probe_canvases must be 0 on this arm and > 0 on m1_left_prefix_admit, otherwise the whole ladder M measurement is void.

Positive matched control for ladder M: the default left-prefix admit_fill on the positionwise MaskGIT path. Every ladder-M candidate's flip rate, forwards delta and gate deltas are computed against this arm and never against a ladder-L arm.

Positive matched control for ladder L: compiler LTR (compiler_decode_mode='tree') with speculative_rank='off', so only the deterministic singleton bypass commits without a forward. Every ladder-L candidate is compared against this arm only.

Quality control: every arm decodes the same records with the same scratch weights, the same tokenizers and the same seed; only the decode-time config differs. No arm trains, and no arm adds a parameter, so EG_params is not in play for any arm of this campaign.

manifest.author: S5
executable_kill_criteria: kill:gate_regression -- any arm whose meaningful_program_rate_delta, structural_similarity_delta or placeholder_fidelity_delta against its own ladder control is < 0 on any suite is killed for that suite; a flip that lowers a gate closes the arm.

kill:m1_joint_rejection -- any block_joint_rejections > 0 recorded under m1_left_prefix_admit semantics (block_diffusion_decode=False, no hybrid span lane) kills the campaign: the joint check would be firing on sequential commits and the instrument, not the lever, is being measured.
kill:timeout -- any arm x suite x seed decode that exceeds `timeout 170` is recorded as a timeout row and yields no number for that cell; a timed-out run is never evidence.
kill:probe_not_live -- admit_probe_canvases must be 0 on m0_admit_probes_off and > 0 on m1_left_prefix_admit; otherwise ladder M is void.
kill:speculation_not_live -- speculative_rank_evaluations must be 0 on l1_singleton_only and > 0 on at least one l2_* arm; otherwise ladder L is void.
kill:cross_ladder_comparison -- comparing any ladder-M arm against a ladder-L arm voids the result; the two decode paths are disjoint.
